name: @potyro/rooms
description: The rooms relay for real-time multiplayer apps (docs/26): wss://<host>/rooms/<roomId>, every frame a member sends goes as-is to every other member of the room, plus a small versioned presence envelope (welcome, join, leave). No persistence, no accounts, no logs of payloads; size, member, per-address and per-connection rate limits, each with its own close code. Depends on no Potyro package. Deployment: docs/16.
